_comment: SKUs whose stock level IS the demo, and which no transactional seeder may
consume. Read by DemoOrderSeeder (and anything else that places seeded
orders) to exclude lines before sampling.
Why this file exists: TransitionOrderStatus => Shipped composes CompleteSale,
which moves stock from reserved to sold and permanently drops
current_quantity. CreateOrder reserves at creation. So a seeder that picks
order lines at random will drain exactly the variations that
docs/reference/schema/demo-data.md names as 'out of stock' and 'exactly one
left' — and that page is the presenter's lookup table for a live demo. The
failure is silent: every seeder run succeeds, the orders look right, and the
This is data rather than a PHP const so the list is readable by anything that
needs it, not only by the one class that must not violate it.
Adding a SKU here is cheap. Removing one means the matrix row it backs is no
longer claimed in demo-data.md — check that page first.

out_of_stock._why: current_quantity = 0 on an otherwise-orderable variation — the add-to-cart refusal path. A single reserved unit destroys it.

exactly_one_left._why: the quantity-validation boundary. Reserving the last unit turns these into out-of-stock and loses the boundary entirely.

unavailable_products._why: is_available = false, so these are excluded from the storefront and can never legitimately appear in a seeded order. Listed by PRODUCT sku — exclude every variation beneath each.

min_order_quantity._why: NOT excluded — these belong in real orders. Listed so a seeder can respect the floor instead of tripping over it, since a quantity below min_order_quantity is refused.
